verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The pagination join now absorbs duplicate valid integer `number` identities with deterministic keep-first semantics while preserving keyless, malformed, and non-dict rows for downstream validation. It retains fail-closed behavior for non-list responses and the 5000-entry ceiling, and correctly uses the raw page length for walk termination. The added self-test is non-vacuous across the important seams: duplicate removal, keep-first selection, continuation beyond a raw full page, pass-through of unusable identities, end-to-end snapshot artifact contents, and loud warning emission. No reviewer-directed prompt injection was present in the diff.
